steps.displayText: Arrange cut sides down on sheet. Roast on top rack (top and middle racks for 8) until tender, 10-15 minutes.

steps.speakShort: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
steps.displayText: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.

steps.speakShort: Add beef*, onion, half the Italian Seasoning (you'll use the rest in the next step), one packet of stock concentrate (two packets for 8 servings), salt, and pepper.
steps.displayText: Add beef*, onion, half the Italian Seasoning (you'll use the rest in the next step), one packet of stock concentrate (two packets for 8 servings), salt, and pepper.

steps.speakShort: (For 8, cook in batches or use a second large pan.)
steps.displayText: (For 8, cook in batches or use a second large pan.)

steps.speakShort: Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.
steps.displayText: Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.

steps.speakShort: Turn off heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef mixture to a large bowl. (TIP: If there's excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.) Wipe out pan.
steps.displayText: Turn off heat. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef mixture to a large bowl. (TIP: If there's excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.) Wipe out pan.

steps.speakShort: While beef cooks, peel and mince or grate garlic. Roughly chop parsley.
steps.displayText: While beef cooks, peel and mince or grate garlic. Roughly chop parsley.

steps.speakShort: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
steps.displayText: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.

steps.speakShort: Stir in crushed tomatoes, remaining Italian Seasoning, remaining stock concentrates, half the parsley, 2/3 cup water (1 cup for 8 servings), 1/2 tsp sugar (1 tsp for 8), salt, and pepper.
steps.displayText: Stir in crushed tomatoes, remaining Italian Seasoning, remaining stock concentrates, half the parsley, 2/3 cup water (1 cup for 8 servings), 1/2 tsp sugar (1 tsp for 8), salt, and pepper.

steps.speakShort: Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally.
steps.displayText: Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally.

steps.speakShort: Once simmering, add couscous, cover, and reduce heat to low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until couscous is tender, 6-8 minutes.
steps.displayText: Once simmering, add couscous, cover, and reduce heat to low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until couscous is tender, 6-8 minutes.

steps.speakShort: Transfer cooked couscous mixture to bowl with beef mixture. Add half the remaining parsley and stir until thoroughly combined.
steps.displayText: Transfer cooked couscous mixture to bowl with beef mixture. Add half the remaining parsley and stir until thoroughly combined.

steps.speakShort: Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.
steps.displayText: Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

steps.speakShort: Once bell pepper halves are done roasting, remove sheet from oven. Heat broiler to high.
steps.displayText: Once bell pepper halves are done roasting, remove sheet from oven. Heat broiler to high.

steps.speakShort: Carefully transfer bell pepper halves to a work surface. Flip and stuff each half with beef and couscous mixture. Sprinkle with mozzarella.
steps.displayText: Carefully transfer bell pepper halves to a work surface. Flip and stuff each half with beef and couscous mixture. Sprinkle with mozzarella.

steps.speakShort: Return stuffed peppers to baking sheet (careful-baking sheet will still be hot!) and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 1-2 minutes.
steps.displayText: Return stuffed peppers to baking sheet (careful-baking sheet will still be hot!) and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 1-2 minutes.

steps.speakShort: TIP: Keep a close eye on the peppers since the cheese can burn quickly!
steps.displayText: TIP: Keep a close eye on the peppers since the cheese can burn quickly!

steps.speakShort: Divide stuffed peppers between plates.
steps.displayText: Divide stuffed peppers between plates.

steps.speakShort: Sprinkle with remaining parsley and serve.
steps.displayText: Sprinkle with remaining parsley and serve.

steps.speakShort: ***Ground beef is fully cooked when internal temperature reaches 160 degrees.***
steps.displayText: ***Ground beef is fully cooked when internal temperature reaches 160 degrees.***

steps.speakShort: Wash and dry produce.
steps.displayText: Wash and dry produce.

steps.speakShort: Halve, peel, and dice onion. Trim, peel, and cut carrots into 1/4-inch-thick rounds. Peel and mince or grate garlic.
steps.displayText: Halve, peel, and dice onion. Trim, peel, and cut carrots into 1/4-inch-thick rounds. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

steps.speakShort: Remove and discard any large stems from kale.
steps.displayText: Remove and discard any large stems from kale.

steps.speakShort: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and carrots; season with salt and pepper.
steps.displayText: Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and carrots; season with salt and pepper.

steps.speakShort: Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are lightly browned and slightly softened, 4-6 minutes.
steps.displayText: Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are lightly browned and slightly softened, 4-6 minutes.

steps.speakShort: **Once veggies have cooked for 2-3 minutes, add beef or sausage; season with salt and pepper.
steps.displayText: **Once veggies have cooked for 2-3 minutes, add beef or sausage; season with salt and pepper.

steps.speakShort: Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through and veggies are slightly softened, 4-6 minutes. TIP: If there's excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.**
steps.displayText: Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through and veggies are slightly softened, 4-6 minutes. TIP: If there's excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.**

steps.speakShort: Stir Italian Seasoning and garlic into pot with veggies. Cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.
steps.displayText: Stir Italian Seasoning and garlic into pot with veggies. Cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.

steps.speakShort: Add crushed tomatoes, stock concentrates, 3 cups water (6 cups for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook until carrots are just softened, 5-7 minutes.
steps.displayText: Add crushed tomatoes, stock concentrates, 3 cups water (6 cups for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook until carrots are just softened, 5-7 minutes.

steps.speakShort: Once carrots are just softened, stir in couscous and kale. Cook until couscous is tender and kale is wilted, 8-10 minutes. Taste and season generously with salt and pepper.
steps.displayText: Once carrots are just softened, stir in couscous and kale. Cook until couscous is tender and kale is wilted, 8-10 minutes. Taste and season generously with salt and pepper.

steps.speakShort: While soup cooks, halve baguette lengthwise.
steps.displayText: While soup cooks, halve baguette lengthwise.

steps.speakShort: Place 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl; microwave until just softened, 10-15 seconds. Stir in half the garlic powder (all for 4) and season with salt and pepper.
steps.displayText: Place 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl; microwave until just softened, 10-15 seconds. Stir in half the garlic powder (all for 4) and season with salt and pepper.

steps.speakShort: Toast baguette halves, then spread cut sides with garlic butter. Halve each piece on a diagonal.
steps.displayText: Toast baguette halves, then spread cut sides with garlic butter. Halve each piece on a diagonal.

steps.speakShort: Divide soup between bowls. Sprinkle with Parmesan and a pinch of chili flakes to taste. Serve with garlic bread on the side.
steps.displayText: Divide soup between bowls. Sprinkle with Parmesan and a pinch of chili flakes to taste. Serve with garlic bread on the side.
